result_text:
I fixed the four default scoping conventions in `ScopingConventions.java` so they match the files they were meant for. The new test passes (5/5), and the full `codeanalyzer` suite passes (335 run, 0 failures, 3 skipped).

The changes, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML pages:** the three pkgdown/Doxygen/meta-generator rules now use `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered.
- **.NET documentation XML:** `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. The `<doc>` content check still applies.
- **JavaScript "// Generated by" rule:** `.*/[.]js` became `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches. The content check still applies.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the new cases match, that `.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle` and `<doc>` XML still match, and that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of those scopes.

I did not confirm that the new test fails on the original code, so that is unverified. Nothing was committed.
